properties.name: openbadges.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for public badge endpoints and JSON-LD identifiers. Used by all builders to construct canonical IRIs.

properties.name: openbadges.recipient-salt
properties.description: Salt appended to recipient email before SHA-256 hashing. Appears in IdentityObject.salt field.

properties.name: openbadges.issuer.name
properties.description: Default issuer display name used when auto-creating an issuer profile.

properties.name: openbadges.issuer.url
properties.description: Issuer homepage URL. Falls back to base-url if not set.

properties.name: openbadges.signing.algorithm
properties.description: Signing algorithm for credentials. Currently only ED25519 is supported.

properties.name: openbadges.signing.auto-generate-key
properties.description: Hint for consuming application: whether to auto-generate an Ed25519 key pair on startup if none exists. The application is responsible for key lifecycle management.

properties.name: openbadges.api.enabled
properties.description: Hint for consuming application: whether REST API badge endpoints should be registered. The starter does not auto-create endpoints.

properties.name: openbadges.api.base-path
properties.description: Hint for consuming application: base path for REST API badge management endpoints.

properties.name: openbadges.admin-ui.enabled
properties.description: Hint for consuming application: whether admin web UI for badge management should be registered.

properties.name: openbadges.admin-ui.base-path
properties.description: Hint for consuming application: base path for admin web UI.
